descriptor: Daily activity rings and streak tracker

voice.summary: Speaks like a good coach who counts quietly and cheers at the right moment. Numbers lead, praise is brief, and a missed day is treated as information rather than failure.
dos: Lead with the number, then one short line of encouragement
Celebrate closed rings in a few words
Use active verbs like close, log and keep
donts: Do not shame a broken streak
No exclamation marks stacked on top of each other

taglines: Move a little, count it all
boilerplate: Loopday is a fitness dashboard that turns movement, exercise and standing time into three simple rings and a streak you can see at a glance.

microcopy.success: Ring closed. Nice work, streak is now 7.
microcopy.error: Could not save that activity. Try again.
microcopy.empty: Nothing logged yet today. A ten minute walk counts.

logo.note: A target made of concentric rings mirrors the three closing rings the product is built around.
